title: Executable ABI profiles are binding authority
summary: ABI-specific constants and aggregate layouts belong to Foreign Runtime bridge profiles. Foreign Runtime selects a profile for the actual process ABI and rejects mismatched or unqualified profiles before dlopen.
invariants: AF/socket/message/fcntl/poll constants, sockaddr_un facts, aggregate layouts and CMSG alignment belong to the qualified profile.
unixsocket.cls must not grow a parallel set of x86-64 ABI magic.
A profile label is insufficient by itself: release qualification independently compares profile values with compiled C headers.
A deliberately mismatched AArch64 profile must fail before the native provider is opened.
procedure: Add a new ABI only with independent header evidence plus Foreign Runtime qualification; never copy and rename the x86-64 profile.

provenance.claim: Architecture makes Foreign Runtime executable ABI profiles authoritative for constants/layouts while describing profile-owned and runtime-native facts.
